 Two teams searching for traction in Serie A meet at Mapei Stadium, with Fiorentina carrying enough momentum from a recent draw to believe they can push up the table, and Sassuolo desperate to arrest a slide that has left them rooted to the bottom. Neither side can afford another stumble, which gives this fixture a sharper edge than the standings might suggest.
 Fiorentina’s most compelling figure is Franco Mastantuono, who has produced 3 goals, 10 shots on target, and 14 chances created — numbers that make him the clearest attacking threat on either roster. Alex Jimenez adds another dimension with 2 goals and 2 assists alongside 13 chances created, giving Fiorentina genuine width and creativity.
 For Sassuolo, Vasilije Adzic has been the standout with 3 goals and 11 chances created, while Cristian Volpato’s 9 chances created and 1 goal show he can unlock defenses. The hosts need those players to deliver at Mapei Stadium, where a home crowd and some urgency could yet produce something worth watching.

 Game Preview
 Fiorentina sit 14th in Serie A with 6 points and a goal differential of -2, while Sassuolo occupy 20th place with just 1 point and a -5 goal differential — the worst in the division. The gap between them is narrow enough in points that a Fiorentina win would further entrench Sassuolo at the foot of the table, making this a genuine six-pointer for the hosts. The most recent head-to-head between these sides ended goalless, a reminder that defensive organization can neutralize attacking ambition when both teams are cautious.
 What to Watch For
 Franco Mastantuono is the player Sassuolo’s defense must account for above all others. His 14 chances created lead everyone in this fixture by a clear margin, and his 3 goals demonstrate he converts as well as he creates. Alongside him, Alex Jimenez — 2 goals, 2 assists, 13 chances created — offers a secondary threat that is nearly as dangerous. Fiorentina have the attacking personnel to punish a Sassuolo side that conceded six against Lazio in their most recent home fixture.
 For Sassuolo, Vasilije Adzic carries the heaviest burden. His 3 goals and 11 chances created make him the focal point of whatever the hosts can build offensively. Sebastiano Esposito contributes 2 goals and 1 assist, and Armand Lauriente’s 8 chances created give Adzic support from wide areas. With Sassuolo sitting on 1 point and needing wins urgently, the pressure on those players to produce something decisive at Mapei Stadium has rarely been higher.
